The '''Benevolence of Troxar''' was an organization that was affiliated with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troxar]] and the [[Troxan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who lived there. The [[Bureau of Diplomatic Liaison]] was a branch of the Benevolence of Troxar.<ref name="YDR 2">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 2.</ref>
